kernel.virtual_memory.limits: SystemResourceSize remains zero. Dynamic physical mapping needs a larger alias region, partial map/unmap support and resource accounting before enabling virtual address allocators.

services.ipc.limits: TIPC supports inline data, PID, handles and map-alias buffers within the 256-byte TLS command buffer; no static buffers or domain messages.

cpu.relocations.limits: ELF64 NSO relative relocations only; RELR targets must stay inside their module and outside the relocation table.

gpu.api.limits: NVN 55 can be requested by a development adapter but has not passed runtime compatibility or gameplay qualification.

cpu.exclusive_pairs.limits: 32/64-bit register pairs use atomic compare-and-swap with address/size reservations. Like single-register exclusives, identical-value ABA writes are not detected; CAS/CASP and MTE are not provided by this capability.

gpu.pool_mapping.limits: Sparse mapping and rebinding remain unsupported.

services.network.limits: Offline service responses only; online play is unavailable.

audio.routing.limits: REV12 biquads and additional effect types remain unsupported; the listed variants cover the tested legacy packet layouts.
